hooks.command: MAIN_WT=$(git worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/worktree //'); if [ "$(pwd)" != "$MAIN_WT" ] && [ ! -d "ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs" ]; then if [ -n "$MAIN_WT" ] && [ -d "$MAIN_WT/ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs" ]; then mkdir -p ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco && ln -s "$MAIN_WT/ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs" ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs && echo "Symlinked Monaco from main worktree"; else ./scripts/setup-monaco.sh; fi; fi

MAIN_WT=$(git worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/worktree //'); if [ "$(pwd)" != "$MAIN_WT" ] && [ ! -f "ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/terminal/xterm.js" ]; then if [ -n "$MAIN_WT" ] && [ -f "$MAIN_WT/ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/terminal/xterm.js" ]; then for f in xterm.js xterm.css addon-fit.js addon-web-links.js; do [ -f "$MAIN_WT/ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/terminal/$f" ] && ln -sf "$MAIN_WT/ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/terminal/$f" "ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/terminal/$f"; done && echo "Symlinked xterm.js from main worktree"; else ./scripts/setup-xterm.sh; fi; fi

MAIN_WT=$(git worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/worktree //'); if [ "$(pwd)" != "$MAIN_WT" ] && [ ! -d "uv-dist" ]; then if [ -n "$MAIN_WT" ] && [ -d "$MAIN_WT/uv-dist" ]; then ln -s "$MAIN_WT/uv-dist" uv-dist && echo "Symlinked uv-dist from main worktree"; else ./scripts/setup-uv.sh; fi; fi

WORKTREE_DIR=$(python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["cwd"])') && cd "$WORKTREE_DIR" && if [ ! -d "ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs" ]; then MAIN_WT=$(git worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/worktree //'); if [ -n "$MAIN_WT" ] && [ -d "$MAIN_WT/ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs" ]; then mkdir -p ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco && ln -s "$MAIN_WT/ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs" ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs && echo "Symlinked Monaco from main worktree"; else ./scripts/setup-monaco.sh; fi; fi

WORKTREE_DIR=$(python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["cwd"])') && cd "$WORKTREE_DIR" && if [ ! -f "ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/terminal/xterm.js" ]; then MAIN_WT=$(git worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/worktree //'); if [ -n "$MAIN_WT" ] && [ -f "$MAIN_WT/ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/terminal/xterm.js" ]; then for f in xterm.js xterm.css addon-fit.js addon-web-links.js; do [ -f "$MAIN_WT/ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/terminal/$f" ] && ln -sf "$MAIN_WT/ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/terminal/$f" "ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/terminal/$f"; done && echo "Symlinked xterm.js from main worktree"; else ./scripts/setup-xterm.sh; fi; fi

WORKTREE_DIR=$(python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["cwd"])') && cd "$WORKTREE_DIR" && if [ ! -d "uv-dist" ]; then MAIN_WT=$(git worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/worktree //'); if [ -n "$MAIN_WT" ] && [ -d "$MAIN_WT/uv-dist" ]; then ln -s "$MAIN_WT/uv-dist" uv-dist && echo "Symlinked uv-dist from main worktree"; else ./scripts/setup-uv.sh; fi; fi
